trap.label: relato de viagem
trap.wrong: When I arrived in Lisbon, I was surprised. I was told that the museum closes at five.
trap.right: When I arrived in Lisbon, I was surprised. I was told that the museum closed at five.
trap.why: Em português “disseram-me que fecha às cinco” mantém o presente. Em inglês, I was told that + verbo recuado (closed). E arrive in cidade, não to.

mcq.q: I was told that it ___ at five.

fix.wrong: I was told it opens at nine.
fix.right: I was told it opened at nine.
